_nguon: GV-1 English overlay — editorial draft awaiting owner review.

mo_thi_truong.nen_de_y: People leaning this way often open many fronts or feel optimistic about cash flow; have someone check the numbers before spending.

kiem_soat_tai_chinh.nen_de_y: People leaning this way are careful and may slow experiments; agree in advance on a test budget that can be spent.

van_hanh.nen_de_y: People leaning this way keep things steady but tend to carry everything; write down which decisions need two people.

khau_con_trong.mo_thi_truong: No one clearly leans toward market growth: name one person accountable for revenue, or hire sales early.
khau_con_trong.kiem_soat_tai_chinh: No one clearly leans toward money and paperwork: use an independent bookkeeper from month one and have two people approve large spending.
khau_con_trong.van_hanh: No one clearly leans toward daily operations: turn delivery and customer care into a checklist and give one person ownership.

du.nhan: The group has someone leaning toward each of the three areas
du.tom_tat: Each core area has a natural owner; what remains is writing down who decides what from day one.

thieu.nhan: The group leans to one side
thieu.tom_tat: Members are strong in similar areas, so they click early on; {khau} has no clear owner yet, so plan for it now.

dieu_le.noi_dung: Agree on a threshold (for example a share of monthly working capital): spending or contracts above it need written sign-off from two people.

dieu_le.tieu_de: Separate salary from profit by share
dieu_le.noi_dung: Full-time operators are paid for their role first; profit after reserves is split by ownership, so neither the doers nor the investors feel shortchanged.
Write down how a stake is valued, who has first right to buy it, and a minimum commitment period, while everyone still gets along.

ty_le_50_50.noi_dung: Name who has the final say in each area (product, budget…) so decisions do not stall when you disagree.

thieu_tai_chinh.tieu_de: When no one owns the money
thieu_tai_chinh.noi_dung: Lock a reserve of a few months of fixed costs that is not used for expansion.

ranh_gioi: This is cultural reference only, to help partners understand each other's working tendencies and split roles; it is not an assessment of anyone and does not replace getting to know each other through real work. The charter points are prompts for discussion only: have a lawyer draft or review any shareholder agreement before signing; this is not legal or investment advice. The person entering data confirms each person consented to the use of their birth date; hieuban.com uses it only for this calculation and does not store it.
